note: MPP (co-authored by Tempo and Stripe: https://github.com/tempoxyz/mpp-specs) is an HTTP authentication scheme, not a well-known-document protocol — it defines no standard discovery file. This document is an LLAAPP-authored pointer to where the real 'Payment' auth-scheme challenge (WWW-Authenticate: Payment ...) can be observed live, provided for agent/crawler convenience.

monetized_endpoints.also_accepts: x402 (X-PAYMENT header, see the JSON body of the same 402 response)
monetized_endpoints.description: Demo monetized endpoint used to validate MPP + x402 discovery. Testnet/demo only, not a live product.
